scope: Independent read of actual public starter/specification, completed control, physical oracle, independent reference, grading, validator, AUTHOR and existing reports. Hash/data/AST checks only; no new scientific sweep, Docker run or model evaluation.
physics_findings: The positive pinned Hessian, independent force-noise covariance .8*T and damping .4 give the declared stationary Gibbs OU process. The baths stay active during observation, so the mixing/plateau interpretation is physically valid.

The phase-stable two-quadrature heterodyne readout fixes the real field correlation, the sign of pair phases and the 1/5 normalization. Its mean field is explicitly included; no intensity reconstruction assumption is required.
The exact Gaussian pair characteristic is exp[-q^2*(Cii+Cjj-2*Cij(t))/2]. The oracle retains the full cross-particle covariance with the correct damped modal factor.

The completed source preserves exact static, tagged-particle and mean-field contributions, but assigns normalized connected self relaxation to the collective covariance. This is a coherent physical closure rather than a malformed modal calculation. A positive multiple of the connected self kernel plus the exact nonnegative plateau remains a stationary covariance kernel.

The independent reference constructs the full 10D drift/noise, solves its Lyapunov equation and matrix exponential, then integrates each observed field pair by 2D Gauss-Hermite quadrature. The physical Hessian and Gaussian model are necessarily shared; the scalar modal response and exponential-of-pair-variance readout formula are not reused.

At coupled equal-time reciprocal-wavevector settings every pair phase is positive and the static response is strictly increasing in K. This proves global calibration injectivity; .817827 is correctly described only as a sampled derivative minimum. Uncoupled finite-delay calibration also agrees exactly.
